metadata.description: Claude Code skills for WordPress developers

plugins.name: wp-effort-estimation
plugins.description: Structured development-effort estimates for WordPress tasks (and React surfaces of WordPress — Gutenberg, Interactivity API, headless).

plugins.name: wp-migration-playbook
plugins.description: Opinionated, production-tested playbook for WordPress content migrations — WP→WP and other-system→WP.

plugins.name: wp-plugin-code-audit
plugins.description: Verification-first code audit for WordPress plugins: security, performance, standards, wp.org guidelines, cross-plugin integration. Produces a markdown report with severity-sorted findings + GO / NO-GO / GO WITH FIXES verdict.

plugins.name: wp-theme-code-audit
plugins.description: Verification-first code audit for WordPress themes (block, classic, hybrid, child): security, performance, theme review standards, child-theme override diffs. Produces a markdown report with severity-sorted findings + GO / NO-GO / GO WITH FIXES verdict. Requires wp-plugin-code-audit.

plugins.name: wp-project-security-audit
plugins.description: Verification-first security and vulnerability audit of a whole WordPress project: inventory, dependency and known-vulnerability sweeps at the production version, vendor compromise, secrets, deploy and exposure, cross-component correlation. Dispatches custom plugins and themes to their component audits. Requires wp-plugin-code-audit and wp-theme-code-audit.

plugins.name: wp-plugin-audit-remediation
plugins.description: The phase after a plugin audit: a per-finding remediation log, an immutable copy of the audited version so citations stay readable, and a PHP token-diff that proves renames / formatter runs / refactors changed no behaviour.

plugins.name: wp-mnemon
plugins.description: Deep architectural analysis of WordPress plugins — what the plugin does, how it works, what triggers what, and how data flows. 13-phase workflow with structured output.

plugins.name: wp-pr-review
plugins.description: Context-aware pull request review for WordPress projects: reviews the PR against its target branch, the task it delivers, the project's rules, and a wp-mnemon map of every touched plugin and theme; re-checks every finding with an independent verifier; writes a review doc with per-line comments and quick-fix suggestions. Requires wp-mnemon.

plugins.name: wp-design-to-block-theme
plugins.description: Turn any rendered web design (URL, dev server or static HTML) into a WordPress block theme: capture the pages, derive theme.json tokens from what they paint, rebuild sections as patterns, templates, and Interactivity API blocks, and gate parity with the design and between the front end and the block editor.

plugins.name: wp-v0-to-block-theme
plugins.description: Translate a v0 (Vercel) design — React/Next + Tailwind + shadcn/ui — into a WordPress block theme: map Tailwind tokens to theme.json and shadcn/ui to core blocks on top of the wp-design-to-block-theme workflow. Requires wp-design-to-block-theme.

plugins.name: wp-claude-design-to-block-theme
plugins.description: Turn a Claude design (a Claude Design canvas or an HTML artifact) into a WordPress block theme: unbundle the canvas into pages, map artboards to routes, and rebuild with the wp-design-to-block-theme workflow. Requires wp-design-to-block-theme.
